data.description: A sloth fleshdreg's bite conjures an amber crust that covers the target and restricts the target's movements. Any creature that takes damage from a sloth fleshdreg's bite attack must succeed at a DC %1 Reflex save or take a -2 penalty on attack rolls and Reflex saves for 1d4 rounds.
data.name: Sinful Bite (Sloth)
